name: com.michaelo.oxgkit.localizationsystem
description: The OxGKit is a system tool kit commonly used in game development based on Unity design (all are independent tools).

samples.description: Demonstrates the required callbacks (onAddSupportedLanguages/onParsingLanguageData/onChangeLanguage), a GameSettings-style language save/restore wrapper, runtime language switching, and GetStringByCode text refresh.

Agent Skill (SKILL.md) that teaches AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex CLI, Cursor, etc.) how to use the LocalizationSystem: the required localization callbacks, ChangeLanguage flow, and GetStringByCode lookups. Copy the skill folder into your agent's skills directory after import (see the sample's README).
